crossrefs.text: And the Spirit lifted me up and carried me back to Chaldea, to the exiles in the vision given by the Spirit of God. After the vision had gone up from me,
As soon as Jesus was baptized, He went up out of the water. Suddenly the heavens were opened, and He saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove and resting on Him.
“Look,” he said, “I see heaven open and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God.”
Then I saw heaven standing open, and there before me was a white horse. And its rider is called Faithful and True. With righteousness He judges and wages war.
Then the cherubim rose upward. These were the living creatures I had seen by the River Kebar.
These were the living creatures I had seen beneath the God of Israel by the River Kebar, and I knew that they were cherubim.
When all the people were being baptized, Jesus was baptized too. And as He was praying, heaven was opened,
He saw heaven open and something like a large sheet being let down to earth by its four corners.

groups.title: Last kings of Judah and the prophets of the exile

crossrefs.text: Each of the cherubim had four faces: the first face was that of a cherub, the second that of a man, the third that of a lion, and the fourth that of an eagle.
The first living creature was like a lion, the second like a calf, the third had a face like a man, and the fourth was like an eagle in flight.
His feet were like polished bronze refined in a furnace, and His voice was like the roar of many waters.
He makes the winds His messengers, flames of fire His servants.
Above Him stood seraphim, each having six wings: With two wings they covered their faces, with two they covered their feet, and with two they were flying.

From what seemed to be His waist up, I saw a gleam like amber, with what looked like fire within it all around. And from what seemed to be His waist down, I saw what looked like fire; and brilliant light surrounded Him.
Their faces looked like the faces I had seen by the River Kebar. Each creature went straight ahead.
His body was like beryl, his face like the brilliance of lightning, his eyes like flaming torches, his arms and legs like the gleam of polished bronze, and his voice like the sound of a multitude.
Their entire bodies, including their backs, hands, and wings, were full of eyes all around, as were their four wheels.
and their wings were touching one another. They did not turn as they moved; each one went straight ahead.
Each creature went straight ahead. Wherever the spirit would go, they would go, without turning as they moved.
When the cherubim stood still, the wheels also stood still, and when they ascended, the wheels ascended with them, for the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.
His body was like beryl, his face like the brilliance of lightning, his eyes like flaming torches, his arms and legs like the gleam of polished bronze, and his voice like the sound of a multitude.
And before the throne was something like a sea of glass, as clear as crystal. In the center, around the throne, were four living creatures, covered with eyes in front and back.

And each of the four living creatures had six wings and was covered with eyes all around and within. Day and night they never stop saying: “Holy, Holy, Holy, is the Lord God Almighty, who was and is and is to come!”
and the fourth row had a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper. These stones were mounted in gold filigree settings.
and I saw the glory of the God of Israel coming from the east. His voice was like the roar of many waters, and the earth shone with His glory.
His body was like beryl, his face like the brilliance of lightning, his eyes like flaming torches, his arms and legs like the gleam of polished bronze, and his voice like the sound of a multitude.
The voice of the LORD is over the waters; the God of glory thunders; the LORD is heard over many waters.
The voice of the LORD twists the oaks and strips the forests bare. And in His temple all cry, “Glory!”
His feet were like polished bronze refined in a furnace, and His voice was like the roar of many waters.
And I heard a sound like the roar of a great multitude, like the rushing of many waters, and like a mighty rumbling of thunder, crying out: “Hallelujah! For the Lord our God the Almighty reigns.
to Him who rides upon the highest heavens of old; behold, His mighty voice resounds.
The LORD thundered from heaven; the voice of the Most High resounded— hailstones and coals of fire.
Then I saw another mighty angel coming down from heaven, wrapped in a cloud, with a rainbow above his head. His face was like the sun, and his legs were like pillars of fire.
I looked and saw a whirlwind coming from the north, a great cloud with fire flashing back and forth and brilliant light all around it. In the center of the fire was a gleam like amber,
Then I looked and saw a figure like that of a man. From His waist down His appearance was like fire, and from His waist up He was as bright as the gleam of amber.
And I looked and saw above the expanse, above the heads of the cherubim, the likeness of a throne of sapphire.
and they saw the God of Israel. Under His feet was a work like a pavement made of sapphire, as clear as the sky itself.
The One seated there looked like jasper and carnelian, and a rainbow that gleamed like an emerald encircled the throne.
Then Abram fell facedown, and God said to him,
“For our God is a consuming fire.”
